content: Sedesiɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ nnɛse yen suru wɔkurusen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurusewɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u Yerusɑlɛmu wɔrimɑ kɑ win tɑbu kowobu kpuro. Yerɑ u win sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ yen bɔkuɔ. Mɑ bɑ kuku yenu kuɑ bɑ kɑ sikerenɑ.
Mɑ bɑ wuu ɡe tɑrusi sere n kɑ kuɑ Sedesiɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑse.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ dɑm kuɑ wuu ɡe sɔɔ. Wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru nnɛsen sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ nnɛse sɔɔ,

Bɑbiloniɡibu bɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ te yɑbɑ. Mɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ duki yɑkurɑ min di wɔ̃kuru bɑɑ mɛ Bɑbiloniɡii be, bɑ wuu ɡe tɑrusi. Yudɑbɑ bɑ yɑrɑwɑ sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru yirun bɑɑ sɔɔn di, sinɑ bokon sɑɑdiɛ̃n bɔkuɔ, Yuudɛnin wɔwɑn berɑ ɡiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Bɑbilonin tɑbu kowo be, bɑ sinɑ boko Sedesiɑsi nɑɑ swĩi. Mɑ bɑ nùn nɑɑmwɛ Yerikon wɔwɑɔ. Yerɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ yɑrinɑ bɑ nùn deri.
Mɑ bɑ nùn mwɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon mi Ribilɑɔ. Miyɑ bɑ nùn siri.
Bɑ win bibu sɑkirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ win tiin nɔni wɔwɑ. Yen biru bɑ nùn bɔkuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndun yɔni yiru bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Bɑ Yerusɑlɛmun tɔn be bɑ tie
yoru mwɛɛrɑ
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑn bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ nnɛse sɔɔ, yen suru nɔɔbusen sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Nɛbusɑrɑdɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii u nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru dɔ̃ɔ mɛni kɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ kpɑɑru, kɑ diɑ ye yɑ ɡesi wɑ̃ kpuro. Ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ dɑmɡibun diɑ u dɔ̃ɔ mɛniwɑ.
Tɑbu kowo be bɑ nùn swĩi bɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑru kɔsukɑ.
Mɑ u Isireli be bɑ tii wɛ̃ kɑ be bɑ tie ɡurɑ u kɑ doonɑ.
Adɑmɑ u mɛɛrɑ be bɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛru bo, mɑ u be deri Yerusɑlɛmu mi, bu kɑ ɡbeɑ wuku, kpɑ bɑ n resɛm sɔmburu mɔ̀.

Bɑbilonin tɑbu kowo be, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɡbere ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu kɔsukɑ, kɑ yen yɔ̃rɑtii kɑ sere mɑɑ boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu ɡè sɔɔ bɑ rɑ nim doke. Mɑ bɑ sii ɡɑn ni kpuro ɡurɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ ten dendi yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu. Niyɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ ni bɑ rɑ kɑ torom ɡure, kɑ kɑɑtonu kɑ wobunu kɑ nɔri.
Kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii wi, win tii u ten doo suɑ kɑ ten ɡbɛ̃ɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu,
kɑ sere sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɡbere yiru ye, kɑ boo ɡe, kɑ yɔ̃rɑtii yi. Dendi yɑ̃ɑ sii ɡɑnduɡii ni Sɑlomɔɔ u kuɑ kpuro, niyɑ bɑ ɡurɑ. Goo kun kpɛ̃ u nin bunum ɡeeru ɡɑri.

Domi ɡbere yen tiɑn ɡunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu yɛndu yiru sɑri. Mɑ bɑ yen wɔllɔ sii ɡɑndu sɔndi nɡe furɔ, ɡɔm soonu itɑ. Yen biru bɑ furɔ ɡe burɑru koosi nɡe mɑnɡon mɑrum. Bɑ ye kpuro kuɑwɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ yiruse kuɑ.
Kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii wi, u yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Serɑyɑ mwɑ, kɑ win yiruse Sofoni, kɑ sere mɑɑ tɔmbu itɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔ kɔ̃su.
Yen biru u tɑbu kowobun wiruɡii ɡoo mwɑ kɑ tɔmbu nɔɔbu sinɑ bokon bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔɔ, kɑ sere tɑbu sunɔn tire yoro wi u rɑ tɔmbu sooɡeru mwɛ, kɑ sere mɑɑ dɑmɡibu ɡɑbu tɔmbu wɑtɑ be bɑ tie wuu ɡe sɔɔ.
Be kpurowɑ u suɑ u kɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko dɑɑwɑ Ribilɑɔ.
Mɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wi, u derɑ bɑ bu so bɑ ɡo Ribilɑ mi, Hɑmɑtin temɔ. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ ɡurɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ tem tukumɔ sere mi n tomɑ.
Bɑ Gedɑliɑ kuɑ
Yudɑbɑn tem yɛ̃ro
Yen biru Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u Gedɑliɑ Akikɑmun bii Sɑfɑnin debubu kuɑ Yudɑ be bɑ tien tem yɛ̃ro.

Sɑɑ ye tɑbu kowobun wiruɡii be bɑ tie Yudɑɔ kɑ ben tɔmbu, bɑ nuɑ mɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u Gedɑliɑ kuɑ ben tem yɛ̃ro, yerɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ Gedɑliɑ win mi Misipɑɔ. Wiruɡii beyɑ Isimɛɛli Nɛtɑniɑn bii kɑ Yokɑnɑni Kɑreɑn bii kɑ Serɑyɑ, Tɑnumɛti Nɛtofɑɡiin bii kɑ Yɑɑsɑniɑ Mɑɑkɑɡiin bii.
Yerɑ Gedɑliɑ u ɡeruɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri u nɛɛ, i ku Bɑbilonin sinɑm ben bɛrum ko. I sinɔ sɛ̃ɛ bɛsɛn tem mɛ sɔɔ kpɑ i ben sinɑ boko wi sɑ̃. Ì n kuɑ mɛ, i ko i dobu nɔ.
Adɑmɑ wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔ, Isimɛɛli Nɛtɑniɑn bii Elisɑmɑn debubu, wi u sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ bii u nɑ, wi, kɑ tɔmbu wɔkuru ɡɑbu bɑ Gedɑliɑ ɡo, kɑ Yudɑbɑ ɡɑbu kɑ mɑɑ Bɑbiloniɡii be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Mɑ Yudɑ be bɑ tie sɑɑ ben wiruɡibun di sere kɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛbɔ, kɑ ben tɑbu kowobun wiruɡii be, bɑ seewɑ bɑ kpikiru suɑ bɑ dɑ Eɡibitiɔ. Domi bɑ Bɑbiloniɡibun bɛrum mɔ.
Bɑ Yoyɑkini yɑrɑ pirisɔm di

Ye bɑ Yoyɑkini Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko mwɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ, yen wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Efili Mɛrodɑki u bɑndu di Bɑbiloniɔ. Wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru wɔkurɑ yirusen sɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ u Yoyɑkini wi yɑrɑ pirisɔm di.
U rɑ kɑ nùn ɡɑri ko kɑ kĩru. Mɑ u nùn ɑye bɛɛrɛɡiru wɛ̃. Win ɑye te, tɑ sinɑm be bɑ yoru dimɔ Bɑbiloniɔ kpuroɡinu kere.
Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wi, u derɑ bɑ Yoyɑkini yɑ̃ɑ kpɑɑnu sebusiɑ dɔmɑ te u nùn yɑrɑ pirisɔm di. Sɑnnɑ bɑ rɑ di sere Yoyɑkini u dɑ u kɑ ɡu.
Yèn bukɑtɑ u mɔ kpuro sinɑ boko wi, u rɑ nùn wɛ̃wɑ bɑɑdommɑ sere kɑ win wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru kpuro sɔɔ.
